source.title: The metadata ecosystem and AI: Enabling FAIR and AI-ready data

interpretation: The source classifies functions of metadata standards. Applying these overlapping categories to paper and dataset evidence is this project's operational adaptation, not a preprocessing prescription from the article.

structure.definition: Entities, descriptive properties, organization, types, dimensions, relationships and structural requirements or constraints.

encoding.definition: Formal representation, serialization and packaging of information for storage, exchange or computation.

value.definition: Controlled terms, concepts, identifiers, codes and semantic value assignments; explicit unit semantics are included in this operational adaptation.
excludes: ordinary measurement numbers as controlled vocabulary
observed sample set asserted as allowed domain

syntax.definition: Ordering, formatting and lexical conventions; this category crosscuts structure, encoding and value.

invariants: Keep full paper input; category indexes are fallible navigation aids, not gold.
A JSON model response does not establish JSON dataset encoding.
Observed values and sampled nullability do not establish universal constraints.
Field-name-derived semantics and units remain inferred.
Preserve evidence origin; dataset facts do not establish paper visibility.
Reuse one fact identity across overlapping category views.
